description.value: Milky Snow is a Korean dessert café situated in the Steveston waterfront district of Richmond, a popular cycling destination at the southern end of the Dyke Trail network. The restaurant specialises in Korean-style desserts, making it a notable sweet-stop option for cyclists exploring the Steveston area. Its Steveston-branded Instagram handle suggests a connection to the historic fishing village and tourist hub.
